title: LLM Runtime Core
summary: This module serves as the core runtime for Large Language Models, managing model loading, inference context, text processing, token sampling, and multimodal data handling. It provides essential functionalities for efficient and controlled LLM execution.

nodes.label: Manage LLM Context & State
nodes.title: LLM Context & State Management
nodes.description: Handles the internal state of the LLM inference context, including saving, loading, querying, and providing utilities for performance monitoring and memory analysis.

nodes.label: Process Text & Sample Tokens
nodes.title: Text Processing & Sampling
nodes.description: Manages text tokenization, detokenization, grammar enforcement, and various token sampling strategies to ensure coherent and controlled text generation.

nodes.label: Handle Model Quantization & I/O
nodes.title: Model Quantization & I/O
nodes.description: Provides functionalities for quantizing LLMs to optimize size and performance, handles GGUF file metadata, and manages the Key-Value (KV) cache during inference.

nodes.label: Process Multimodal Inputs
nodes.title: Multimodal Tooling for LLMs
nodes.description: Offers core functionalities for processing and encoding multimodal data, such as images and audio, for integration and use with Large Language Models.

nodes.label: Provide Common Utilities
nodes.title: Common Utilities
nodes.description: Contains general-purpose utility functions for system interaction, string manipulation, model initialization, optimization parameter handling, and logging within the LLM ecosystem.

nodes.label: ML Backend (GGML)
nodes.title: GGML Machine Learning Backend
nodes.description: The underlying machine learning backend responsible for executing tensor operations, managing memory, and performing computations on various hardware (CPU, GPU).

nodes.label: File System
nodes.title: Operating System File System
nodes.description: The operating system's file system, used for persistent storage, loading model files, saving session states, and managing cache data.

nodes.label: System Resources
nodes.title: System Hardware Resources
nodes.description: Represents the underlying hardware resources of the system, including CPU information, memory, and other performance-related metrics.

groups.label: LLM Core Engine
groups.title: Core LLM Inference & Generation
groups.description: This group encapsulates the fundamental components for managing the LLM's operational state and generating text based on input and configured parameters.

groups.label: Data & Model Lifecycle
groups.title: Model & Data Preparation
groups.description: Manages the lifecycle of LLM models, including optimization through quantization, handling file I/O, and processing diverse multimodal inputs for inference.

groups.label: System Integration & Utilities
groups.title: System Interaction & Support
groups.description: Provides essential utilities for interacting with the operating system, managing files, querying system resources, and interfacing with the underlying machine learning backend.
